2. ENTERPRISE EXPERIENCE (CHiPS & HEALTH DEPARTMENT)
================================================================================
Organization: Chhattisgarh Infotech Promotion Society (CHiPS)
Deployment: Department of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Chhattisgarh
Role: Data Analyst / BI Developer Intern
Timeline: June 2025 – March 2026
Location: Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India

Core Project 1: Statewide Biometric Attendance & Payroll Reconciliation
- Context: Statewide healthcare institutions and public health facilities recorded biometric punch records via Aadhaar-Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS), while salary disbursal was governed by the State Treasury payroll systems.
- Problem: Identity records did not map automatically due to non-standard naming, regional transliteration, and mismatched employee identifiers. Department leadership could not verify actual physical presence or stop salary leakage for non-compliant bonded doctors.
- Solution: Engineered multi-stage SQL/ETL pipelines using Common Table Expressions (CTEs), multi-table joins, regex string cleansing, and deterministic identity resolution. Consolidated disparate tables from MariaDB and OracleDB.
- Impact: Comprehensive statewide data reconciliation across all administrative districts. Identified salary leakage cases and established continuous compliance monitoring for the Health Department Secretary.

Core Project 2: Multi-Tier Defaulter Risk Classification Model
- Designed rule-based risk classification segmenting bonded medical personnel:
  * Tier 1: Non-Reporting (Allocated facility but never showed up).
  * Tier 2: Formal Registration Only (Registered in records but missing regular biometrics).
  * Tier 3: Severe Attendance Deficit (Active in payroll but attendance below operational threshold).
- Generated weekly exception audit workbooks in Advanced Excel with Power Query automation, delivered directly to the Department Secretary.

Core Project 3: Production Power BI Executive Suite
- Designed Kimball Star Schema with central fact table and dimensional tables for districts, facilities, cadres, and dates.
- Authored custom DAX measures for attendance compliance %, rolling operational average work hours, peak late-login trends, and variance metrics.
- Structured multi-level drill-down hierarchy: District → Facility → Designation → Individual Employee.

Core Project 4: Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Multi-Criteria ABC/VED/SDE Matrix
- Categorized statewide essential drug catalogs in OracleDB and Advanced Excel across clinical directorates.
- Implemented ABC (monetary consumption value), VED (Vital, Essential, Desirable), and SDE (Scarce, Difficult, Easy) classification.
- Deployed interactive procurement scorecards in Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) to eliminate localized drug stockouts and optimize vendor batch lead times.

================================================================================
3. FLAGSHIP RESEARCH & ENGINEERING PROJECTS
================================================================================
Project 1: Proactive 5G mmWave Handover Prediction via Diffusion Models (M.Tech Thesis)
- Objective: Replace reactive 5G handover protocols (Time-to-Trigger bottleneck) that cause radio link failures (RLF) in mmWave frequencies.
- Method: Built a spatio-temporal Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) encoder combined with a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM/DDIM) to generate forward-looking signal degradation trajectories (RSRP, RSRQ, CINR).
- Handled extreme class imbalance using SMOTE + Tomek Links and custom dual-masking loss.
- Evaluated trajectories using an explainable Random Forest policy classifier, achieving high-precision F1-score and zero radio link failure rate in simulation.

Project 2: Dual-Engine AI vs. Human Text Classification Pipeline
- Benchmarked dense transformer BERT embeddings + XGBoost against a multi-branch deep architecture (Bi-LSTM + Multi-Head Attention Transformers + 1D-CNN).
- Reached high-precision and high-recall benchmarks on synthetic vs. authentic text detection.

Project 3: Career-Ops Autonomous Job Acquisition & ATS Auto-Apply Pipeline
- Built an open-source Python recruitment pipeline connecting to enterprise ATS endpoints (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters).
- Concurrent link liveness auditor with multi-pattern expiration heuristics.
- Pure Python standard library OpenXML spreadsheet engine (zero pip dependencies).
- Headless Playwright auto-apply runner with stealth anti-bot evasion and visual screenshot audit trails.
